authorizationText: La idea es que configures tú lo más que puedas sin depender de mí. Auditoría de Cloud Shell confirma WIF y APIs y ausencia de secretos; reducir mis acciones al mínimo para completar MCP.
reason: Prepare one opt-in, idempotent Cloud Shell script to set up only the two new MCP secret containers (empty) and narrowly scoped runtime SecretAccessor bindings and deployer ServiceAccountUser on runtime, using existing project and identities. Never read/write secret values, never deploy Cloud Run or touch Classroom and Site. Run by user only once in authenticated Cloud Shell because connected tools lack Google Cloud IAM/Secret Manager write access. Add CI regressions and explicit documentation. Neither GitHub Actions nor assistant executes privileged GCP IAM modifications without user account access.
